title: Print Window Composability
description: Add generic non-registered Window chrome primitive plus fixed-gutter horizontal composition macros (SemioWindowRowTwo/SemioWindowRowThree) to print LaTeX stack. Rebuild makecoverpages as 6 vertically-stacked window rows plus 3 side-by-side logo windows. Add antragstellendeinstitution/kooperationspartner metadata fields. Update zwischenbericht and template call sites.
summary: Added composable print windows mirroring the UI layout system: generic non-registered `Window` environment (structural tier chrome, no counter/register), `SemioWindowRowTwo`/`SemioWindowRowThree` with fixed `\semio@spacing@single` gutter, new `\antragstellendeinstitution{}` and `\kooperationspartner{}` metadata fields, and rebuilt `\makecoverpages` as 6 stacked window rows plus a 3-column logo row (Zukunft Bau, BBSR, BBR). Updated zwischenbericht light/dark and zukunftbau template call sites. Verified: `bun ./script.ts test` (12 PDFs), mit-bestand zwischenbericht build, cover-page raster spacing (~0.2em gaps, logo gutter ~9px).
